Frequently asked questions

The questions we are asked most often at the studio door.

Is the stoneware dishwasher safe?

Yes. Every piece is fired to 1260C and is safe in the dishwasher and the microwave.

How long does a commission take?

Restaurant commissions take 8 to 12 weeks from deposit to delivery.

Do you ship outside the UK?

Yes, to the EU at £14.50. We do not currently ship outside Europe.

Can I visit the studio?

The shop is open Thursday to Sunday, 10:00 to 17:00, at 41 Walmgate, York.

What is your returns policy?

Returns are accepted within 30 days if the piece is unused and in its original packaging.
